title: Papad Kurr Kurr Song | Pappu Flies Away! Fun Kids Rhyme for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
Pappu the little papad goes flying on a windy day, and the whole family rushes to catch him!
This song teaches toddlers that when something goes wrong, we say sorry, work together, and help each other stay safe.
Sing along, dance, and crunch with Pappu!

Kurr kurr!

Pappu sits on the mat, up on the terrace high
Wind comes blowing, whoosh, whoosh!
Up, up he goes, flip, flap, flutter
Pappu's flying, flying far away into the sky!
Kurr kurr papad, kurr kurr papad
Please don't fly away, stay, stay, stay!
Catch him, catch him, hop, hop, hop!
We will hold you, hold you, stay, stay!
Over the wall he goes, zoom, zoom, zoom
Down in Dadi's lap he lands
Ha ha ha, Dadi laughs, a big, big hug, hug, hug!
Pappu's safe and sound!
Kurr kurr papad, kurr kurr papad
Please don't fly away, stay, stay, stay!
Catch him, catch him, hop, hop, hop!
We will hold you, hold you, stay, stay!
Sorry, sorry, Pappu, sorry
We should have held you tight
Back to the mat, tip, tap, tap
Let's put you back to bed tonight!
Kurr kurr papad, kurr kurr papad
Please don't fly away, stay, stay, stay!
Catch him, catch him, hop, hop, hop!
We will hold you, hold you, stay, stay!
Amma calls out loud, "Come and eat, come, come and eat!"
Hot, hot oil, sizzle, sizzle, pop
Kurr kurr, crunch, crunch, crunch
Yum, yum, yum, what a crunchy, crispy end!
